title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission Arrives on Crunchyroll
excerpt:
The 2021 anime film joins the service five years after its debut.
Japanese and English audio are available in supported regions.
body_md:
My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission is now available to stream on Crunchyroll, giving fans another way to revisit Deku's international adventure. The film originally premiered in 2021 and has previously been distributed through theatrical, digital and physical releases. Availability on Crunchyroll depends on the viewer's region, with Japanese and English audio offered where supported.

Directed by Kenji Nagasaki for studio Bones, the movie follows Deku and fellow young heroes as they join professional heroes on a mission with worldwide stakes. The larger geographical scope distinguishes it from many of the series' school-centered stories and offers a glimpse of how the franchise's hero society operates beyond Japan.

The addition comes during a period of anniversary celebrations for the franchise. My Hero Academia Ultra Expo is scheduled for April 17–18, 2027, in Japan, bringing together people who worked on the anime. The event may inspire speculation about future projects, but no new television season or feature film has been confirmed as part of this announcement.
